verdict.rationale: First-party README examples load and run GGUF-packaged models directly, e.g. `llama cli -hf ggml-org/Qwen3.5-0.8B-GGUF` and `llama serve -hf ...-GGUF`. The README also documents 1.5- to 8-bit quantization. Community reports corroborate running quantized models (Q6_K near-FP16 perplexity, quantized multimodal Gemma-3) hands-on. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the GGUF format itself and loading local .gguf files (e.g. via a model-path flag), plus independent reports that name GGUF files specifically.
